meta.tagline: The leaderboard for livestreamers. Bid your way to the top.

nav.bid: Bid your way to the top

home.title: Pay to get seen
home.subtitle: A leaderboard for livestreamers. Anyone can outbid whoever's in first place — the highest bid wins the spot and gets seen by the most viewers.
home.empty: No streamers in this category yet. Be the first!
home.ctaTitle: Want to be at the top?
home.ctaBody: Place a bid and take the current #1 spot right after payment.

bidForm.title: Bid your way to the top
bidForm.intro: Fill in the form below. Your bid activates immediately after payment is approved, and your channel jumps straight to its spot on the leaderboard.
bidForm.name: Channel / streamer name
bidForm.logoHint: PNG, JPG, WEBP or SVG, max 2 MB.
bidForm.emailHint: Used for your receipt and contact about your listing
bidForm.withdrawal: I understand the service activates immediately, and that I therefore waive my right of withdrawal under the Swedish Distance Selling Act.

errors.description: The description can be at most 150 characters
errors.bidTooLow: Your bid is too low. The minimum bid right now is {amount}.
errors.withdrawal: You must confirm that you waive your right of withdrawal to continue.
errors.terms: You must agree to the terms and privacy policy.
errors.logoTooLarge: The image is too large. Max 2 MB.
errors.logoInvalidType: That file type isn't supported. Use PNG, JPG, WEBP or SVG.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

siteSummary.eyebrow: Some stats about this side project since launching {days, plural, =0 {today} =1 {1 day ago} other {# days ago}}

featured.noPreview: Preview isn't supported for this platform yet.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may be broken, or the page may have been removed.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.body: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again shortly.

thanks.title: Thanks for your bid!
thanks.paid: Your payment went through and your spot on the leaderboard is active.
thanks.pending: We're waiting for confirmation from Stripe. This page will update automatically shortly.
thanks.failed: We couldn't confirm the payment. Contact us if you were charged.
thanks.receiptNote: A receipt with VAT details will be sent to your email.

cookieBanner.text: We only use cookies that are strictly necessary for the site to work. We don't use any analytics or marketing cookies without your consent.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Questions about your listing or payment, or want to request deletion of your data? Get in touch.
